Method of Attack: Uses Windows Cache Manager to evade detection by anti-ransomware solutions by encrypting file contents stored in memory cache rather than on disk, causing the Windows Cache Manager (running as a System process) to write encrypted data back to files, bypassing behavioral detection.
Employs advanced techniques such as alternate data streams, UAC bypasses, and hashing of function names.
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Windows Cache Manager to encrypt cached file contents
Behavioral evasion by writing encrypted data via Windows System process
Distribution methods detected by Sophos CryptoGuard and HitmanPro.Alert
